q: The Price Variation Clause is not applicable to:

options.A: Works costing less than Rs.2 Crores
options.C: Service Tenders of less than 18 months

e: The Price Variation Clause is not applicable to works costing less than Rs.2 crore, zonal contracts, or service tenders of less than 18 months; for works, PVC applies only where the advertised value exceeds Rs. 2 crore and the completion period exceeds 12 months. (Source: GCC April-2022, Clause 46A.1 (ACS-1 dated 14.07.2022), consolidated up to ACS-12.)
